title.ur: Indoor unit ka float switch protection on ho gaya

meaning.en: Water is not draining from the unit and the float safety switch has activated.
meaning.ur: Unit se paani nahi nikal raha aur float safety switch on ho gaya

causes.en: High water level in the drain pan, drain-pipe or drain-pan abnormality, or float-switch activation.
causes.ur: Drain pan mein paani ki level zyada, drain pipe ya drain pan ki kharabi, ya float switch on hua

causes.en: Water is not draining from the unit and the float safety switch has activated.
causes.ur: Unit se paani nahi nikal raha aur float safety switch on ho gaya

solutions.en: Clear the drain pan and drain pipe and free the float switch.
